metadata.note: Rear pair and front pair (longer pipes around the radiator) join, then one collector through the single silencer. Every pipe is an estimate. Silencer, catalyst and collector-box bodies are straight pipes of their inlet diameter. Valve: two exhaust valves of 23 mm and 8.0 mm lift (estimates); about 285 deg seat to seat from 50 BBDC / 20 ATDC at 1 mm (Honda manual via owners' club).
